content.text:
Repaint this image as a flat COLOUR-CODED REGION MAP for a segmentation mask.

Keep the exact same creature, pose, size, position and framing: every part must stay exactly where it is, pixel for
pixel. Change only the colours: fill each part completely with its one flat colour from this table:

- #D9002B  mantle_shell: The large central triangular dome forming the creature's upper head, including its pale oval markings and outer outline.
- #00A83B  side_fins: The two broad triangular wing-like flaps projecting behind the mantle on the upper left and upper right.
- #FF7A00  face_frame: The pale rounded frame across the lower mantle that completely surrounds the dark visor, including its small rivets.
- #240099  visor: The single dark rounded rectangular window centered inside the face frame.
- #66FFFF  eyes: The pair of vertical glowing oval eyes set separately inside the left and right halves of the visor.
- #0057D9  side_pods: The two metallic housings attached immediately outside the face frame, one on each side of the head.
- #CC00B8  tentacles: All curling appendage masses below and beside the head, including the four large pale-and-pink arms and the smaller darker rear appendages.
- #638F00  tentacle_joints: The exposed collars, pivots, dark connectors, and mechanical bases separating the tentacles from the head and from their articulated segments.
- #CCFF66  suction_cups: All dark-ringed circular openings on the bulbous ends and inner sides of the tentacles.
- #7600FF  central_nozzle: The small glowing cylindrical jet or nozzle hanging at the exact center beneath the face.

Rules:
- Each part is ONE solid flat colour, exactly the hex value given. No shading, no gradients, no highlights, no texture.
- No outlines, no black lines, no borders between parts: colour regions touch directly.
- Background (everything that is not the creature, including any ground shadow): pure white #FFFFFF.
- No text, no labels, no legend, nothing added.
- Do not move, resize, redraw or restyle anything; only recolour.
